name: Neo Red-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
text:
"Red-Eyes Black Dragon" + "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" + "Red-Eyes Black Dragon"
At the start of the Damage Step, if this is the only face-up monster you control, you can banish 2 "Red-Eyes" monsters from your GY, this card can Attack twice the turn this effect is activated. When a monster effect is activated while this card is in the GY you can banish this card, negate the activation, and if you do that cards effects are negated. you can only activate each effect of "Neo Red-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" Once per turn.
